The evidence, therefore, for a secular origin disappears ; it is
curious, indeed, that Professor Hillebrandt} himself adduces
proof that the western parallel of the Vidiisaka is connected with
religious ceremonies rather than a secular creation. But what is
most remarkable of all is that Professor Konow adduces as
evidence of the secular origin of the drama the Yatras, which are
essentially bound up with the religion of Krsna, and the rough
